items.q: The myelin sheath around an axon:
options: insulates it and speeds up impulses
items.explain: Impulses jump between the nodes of Ranvier, so they travel faster.
items.explainAf: Impulse spring tussen die knope van Ranvier, dus beweeg hulle vinniger.

items.q: Which neuron carries impulses from receptors to the central nervous system?
items.qAf: Watter neuron dra impulse van reseptore na die sentrale senuweestelsel?
items.explain: Sensory (afferent) neurons carry impulses to the CNS.
items.explainAf: Sensoriese (afferente) neurone dra impulse na die SSS.

items.q: Multiple sclerosis damages myelin. A likely result is:
items.qAf: Veelvuldige sklerose beskadig miëlien. ’n Waarskynlike gevolg is:
items.explain: Without myelin, impulses travel slowly or are lost.
items.explainAf: Sonder miëlien beweeg impulse stadig of gaan verlore.

items.q: At a synapse, the impulse crosses the gap by means of:
items.qAf: By ’n sinaps gaan die impuls oor die gaping deur middel van:
options: an electrical current through the gap
items.explain: Neurotransmitters diffuse across the synaptic cleft.
items.explainAf: Neuro-oordragstowwe diffundeer oor die sinaptiese spleet.

items.explain: Neurotransmitter is released only by the presynaptic neuron.
items.explainAf: Neuro-oordragstof word net deur die presinaptiese neuron vrygestel.

items.q: In a reflex arc, the correct order is:
items.qAf: In ’n refleksboog is die korrekte volgorde:
options: receptor → sensory neuron → interneuron → motor neuron → effector
receptor → motor neuron → sensory neuron → effector
optionsAf: reseptor → sensoriese neuron → interneuron → motoriese neuron → effektor
reseptor → motoriese neuron → sensoriese neuron → effektor
items.explain: The impulse passes through the spinal cord without first going to the brain.
items.explainAf: Die impuls gaan deur die rugmurg sonder om eers na die brein te gaan.

items.q: The fatty sheath around an axon that speeds up the impulse.
items.qAf: Die vetagtige skede om ’n akson wat die impuls versnel.

items.q: The chemical released at a synapse that carries the impulse across.
items.qAf: Die chemikalie wat by ’n sinaps vrygestel word wat die impuls oordra.

items.q: The gaps in the myelin sheath, where the impulse "jumps".
items.qAf: Die gapings in die miëlienskede, waar die impuls "spring".

items.text: A [[]] neuron carries impulses from receptors to the central nervous system. A [[]] neuron carries impulses to effectors.
items.textAf: ’n [[]] neuron dra impulse van reseptore na die sentrale senuweestelsel. ’n [[]] neuron dra impulse na effektore.

items.q: Synapses make sure impulses travel in one direction only.
items.qAf: Sinapse verseker dat impulse net in een rigting beweeg.
items.explain: True. Neurotransmitter is only released from the axon end and only detected by the next dendrite.
items.explainAf: Waar. Neuro-oordragstof word net aan die aksonpunt vrygestel en net deur die volgende dendriet waargeneem.

items.q: Multiple sclerosis is caused by damage to the cerebellum.
items.qAf: Veelvuldige sklerose word deur skade aan die serebellum veroorsaak.
items.explain: False. Multiple sclerosis is caused by damage to the myelin sheaths of neurons.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Veelvuldige sklerose word deur skade aan die miëlienskedes van neurone veroorsaak.

items.q: Put the events at a synapse in order.
items.qAf: Rangskik die gebeure by ’n sinaps in volgorde.
steps: Impulse arrives at the end of the axon
Neurotransmitter is released into the synaptic cleft
It binds to receptors on the next neuron
A new impulse starts in the next neuron
stepsAf: Impuls bereik die punt van die akson
Neuro-oordragstof word in die sinaptiese spleet vrygestel
Dit bind aan reseptore op die volgende neuron
’n Nuwe impuls begin in die volgende neuron
